_about: One entry per app version. The pre-push gate (tools/release_docs_gate.py) refuses to push a version without one. Each field says 'updated: what' or 'n/a: why'. guide = the in-app user guide (and menucaptain-help.md via export_help.js); promo = the living promo inventory (CG Apps\MenuCaptain\MenuCaptain Promo\living-promo-template.html); email_notes = next issue's notes (MenuCaptain Updates\next-issue-notes.md); welcome = welcome.html, the public promo page; handoff = HANDOFF.md section + BRIEFING.md rows + a MenuCaptain Log entry. Started 2026-10-16 after Chris asked, again, that every document stay current.
